newsitem.title: USA: Melville to spin off Footstar to holders.
newsitem.headline: Melville to spin off Footstar to holders.

text.p: Melville Corp said on Tuesday it planned to spin off Footstar Inc to its shareholders, as one of the last steps in its strategic restructuring program.

Melville said in a statement it would distribute 100 percent of Footstar common stock to shareholders of record at the close of business on October 2. Shareholders would receive 0.2879 shares of Footstar for every one common Melville share held on the record date, it said.
After the distribution, there would be about 30.5 million Footstar common shares outstanding, Melville said.
Melville also said Footstar common stock had been approved for listing on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol FTS.N, but was subject to official notice of issuance.
Footstar had sales from continuing operations of $1.6 billion in 1995, Melville said.
